searchText: Ideally it would wait some amount of time for progress and then recreate. 6 months maybe is a bit too long, if someone says "don't mark as withdrawn" and then proceeds to do nothing, we should prompt to withdraw again. 1 week is a bit short, but if that is the "no work required" option I am fine with it. Assuming that we fix the bug where it opens a stagnant PR when there is already an open PR on the EIP. Sure, it's very easy to change the frequency. Once a month for example
